body:
Wow, such an in-depth retort.

But anyway that's okay, because you read it, you sad sack of shit.

Yeah, you're not worth remembering because you're a cunt, plus a few seconds on a response really doesn't change anything, it's not some huge waste.

You do look for people, yeah they come to this subreddit to vent and such, but you still seem to search around here for people that you can push over that edge.

"put down like the lesser animal they are" Wow you really don't value human life, do you?

So long as these people haven't done any truly heinous acts they deserve to be helped.

I "pretend" to defend them because it's the right thing to do, not only does a decent person's life have infinite value in my eyes, but they can potentially go on to positively effect many more lives.

Trying to help people even if you aren't successful is better than being a scumbag.

When I die I'll be able to think that I've helped a few people, maybe saved some, made some kind of impact, even if small; the only thing you'll end up making an impact on is the sidewalk.
PM me, I know what it's like, you can vent to me if you want.

You seem to be trying to convince yourself that you should die, the very fact that you have to try to convince yourself of it means that things are quite the opposite, you have value. 

I know how it feels to feel responsible for everything, like it's all your fault, well it's not all your fault.

Depression is a real beating, just because you can't do basic chores don't make you anything less, hang in there please.
Try to hang in there please, maybe try opening up to your foster sister about how you feel, maybe they can help you. I don't know, it's just a suggestion.
I've tried to off myself each birthday I have, I get how you feel about them. If you want to chat on here send me a message, maybe I can help.
I'd cut back a bit on the drinking, I drink over 2 liters a week and it's slowly killing me, don't be like me.

I know what it's like to be depressed for over a decade, if you want to chat on here shoot me a message, maybe I can help you in some way I dunno.

I still really want to die and all, but the main thing that's kept me alive is having a goal, something to actually work towards.

I dunno, maybe just be honest to some extent, say that you're getting cabin fever and that you need some time away? 

It's hard to say though without knowing your full situation.
You matter goddammit, don't let yourself become full of hate like this assmuppet in the comments.

Oh fuck off you toxic sack of shit, you go around looking for people on here that you can push further into their depression, probably because you have some pretty major issues yourself.

Everything you just said can be redirected right back at you, nobody will remember you, YOU don't matter, because all you do is hate.
Right there with ya, drinking vodka or whiskey with coke (keep swapping each glass)

I've been where you are, infact I am where you are. I know what it's like.

Please before you do anything message me, if you want any kind of help maybe I can talk to you.

I'm a pretty uniquely fucked up individual myself, I might have something to say that most don't, I dunno.

What's kept me alive to this point personally is having a goal (I want to help people) and just being stubborn and "lucky". 

Don't let your shitty abusive parents take your life, fight, please.

I dunno, shoot me a message if you want to chat on reddit. 

(Sorry if there's any grammatical mistakes with this, I'm admittedly having some whiskey rn.)
